hypothesis: A coherent market-anchored score distribution with strongly shrunk chronology-trained football residual corrections can improve margin and total forecasts without materially degrading winner-probability quality relative to the market.
training_policy: For each validation season S in 2022-2025, fit only on completed seasons < S. Never use 2026 outcomes.

distribution.family: bivariate normal over home-minus-away margin and game total
distribution.margin_sigma: estimated on prior-season market margin residuals only
distribution.total_sigma: estimated on prior-season market total residuals only
distribution.residual_correlation: estimated on prior-season market margin/total residual pairs only

large_disagreement_guardrail.rationale: Phase 2 found historical model-vs-market margin gaps >=6 points had materially worse MAE than market.
large_disagreement_guardrail.policy: The residual candidate may move market margin by at most 3 points and market total by at most 4 points. No exception or post-result rescue search is allowed in this experiment.

qualification_rule.winner_probability: Candidate must not have statistically supported degradation vs raw market on Brier or log loss.
qualification_rule.margin: Candidate must improve market-spread MAE with season+week blocked uncertainty supporting improvement.
qualification_rule.total: Candidate must improve market-total MAE with season+week blocked uncertainty supporting improvement.
qualification_rule.coherence: Zero algebraic coherence failures between probability distribution, fair margin, total and score means.
qualification_rule.promotion: No production promotion is authorized by historical qualification alone.

prohibited_inputs: closing-line information unavailable at the tested forecast horizon when later matched-horizon testing begins
